name: J. H. Teller
mentions: …following persons registered at the Northern Pacific since last issue: Geo. Auld, Belfield; J. A. Rea, J. H. Teller, Bismarck; D. O. Sweet and wife, Belfield; D. E. Stoney, Cleveland, Ohio; M. Wadsworth, F. A. Willard, Coll McClellan, City; W. Foley, Bismarck; H. S. Boice, E. S. Newma…
Territorial secretary J. H. Teller and Register Rea, both of Bismarck, visited Medora last Sunday. They went away well impressed with the good qualities of the Bad Lands.
